title: GCP Project Module
description: Provisions one or more GCP Projects. The input is a map where each key is the project_id and each value is a configuration object.

project_config.description: Configuration for a single GCP Project.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the project. Defaults to the project_id if empty.

folder_id.description: Parent folder in the form 'folders/1234567890'. Mutually exclusive with org_id.

org_id.description: Parent organization ID (numeric). Mutually exclusive with folder_id.

billing_account.description: Billing account ID in the form '0X0X0X-0X0X0X-0X0X0X'. Required for any project that will create billable resources.

labels.description: Key-value labels applied to the project. Keys and values must follow GCP label rules (lowercase, digits, hyphens, underscores).

auto_create_network.description: When true, GCP creates the default VPC network in the project. Keep false unless you specifically want the default network.

lock.description: When true, attaches a google_resource_manager_lien that prevents project deletion.

deletion_policy.description: Controls what happens to the project on `terraform destroy`. DELETE removes it, PREVENT blocks destruction, ABANDON leaves it in place.

key_spec.label: project_id
key_spec.description: Globally-unique GCP project_id. 6-30 chars. Must start with a lowercase letter, end with a letter or digit, and contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.
